children.text: Myelodysplasia is a common group of congenital disorders caused by various chromosomal abnormalities that lead to the failure of closure of the fetal spinal cord and present with anatomic anomalies and neurological impairment of varying degree.
Diagnosis can be made in utero with fetal ultrasound.
Treatment involves a multidisciplinary approach to address neurological, genitoturinary, and orthopedic manifestations.
